## Routing Decision

**Source:** LAW-005 — "December 2022 fuel-stimulus agreement"
**Target chapter:** 5B (Economic Wellbeing)
**Routing mode:** High-recall (non-scoring calibration)

---

### Chunk U0001

**Locator:** extracted HTML block 1
**Decision:** **INCLUDE**

**Adjacent context:** U0001 is the preamble/authority block. It establishes institutional origin (Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público, Unidad de Política de Ingresos no Tributarios), legal basis (Decree Dec 27, 2016; Decree March 4, 2022), and the announcement that percentages, amounts, and diminished quotas for the special production tax on fuels will be disclosed for the period Dec 10–16, 2022.

**Applicable 5B lenses:**

| Lens ID | Relevance rationale |
|---|---|
| 5B.1 | Formal policy announcement; fiscal stimulus as legislative/executive agenda item |
| 5B.2 | Names Karina Ramírez Arras as Titular de la Unidad de Política de Ingresos no Tributarios — institutional role, professional appointment context |
| 5B.3 | Cites binding fiscal decrees; establishes the regulatory framework governing the stimulus |
| 5B.9 | December 2022 timing is consistent with commodity/energy price shock response |

**Exclusion reason:** N/A — chunk is included.

---

### Chunk U0002

**Locator:** extracted HTML block 2
**Decision:** **INCLUDE**

**Adjacent context:** U0002 is the substantive data block containing four tables: (1) stimulus percentages by fuel type, (2) stimulus monetary amounts in pesos/liter, (3) diminished quotas in pesos/liter, and (4) complementary stimulus quantities. The transitory article establishes entry into force. The signatory reaffirms the same authority cited in U0001.

**Applicable 5B lenses:**

| Lens ID | Relevance rationale |
|---|---|
| 5B.1 | Executed fiscal stimulus policy — concrete percentages and pesos/liter amounts represent the translated policy stance |
| 5B.3 | The tables are the administered fiscal/quota regime; reflects enacted tax rules for the period |
| 5B.6 | Budget expenditure implications — stimulus fiscal amounts represent government spending allocation on fuel |
| 5B.8 | **Direct distributional signal:** Diesel stimulus at 59.77% vs. lower-octane gasoline at 26.96%; premium gasoline and non-fossil fuels receive 0% stimulus. Differential rates imply class/region/use-pattern distributional incidence |
| 5B.9 | The fixed biweekly reset period (Dec 10–16, 2022) and the magnitude of stimuli are consistent with targeted shock intervention in fuel markets |

**Exclusion reason:** N/A — chunk is included.

---

### Routing Summary

| chunk_id | Decision | Cited lenses |
|---|---|---|
| U0001 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.2, 5B.3, 5B.9 |
| U0002 | **INCLUDE** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.6, 5B.8, 5B.9 |

**Note:** This source is a single-period fuel-tax stimulus schedule. It provides snapshot fiscal data but lacks budget execution records, distributional impact studies, or longitudinal outcomes — so lenses 5B.4, 5B.5, 5B.7, and 5B.10 cannot be applied to this chunk alone. Chunks U0001 and U0002 together constitute the complete source body; neither chunk is independently sufficient.
